No real-time or hardware claim is made; deadline_misses and mean_complete_update_s are runtime/policy observations distinct from raw solver termination.
Zero force_bound_violation_n at tested points does not exclude legal near-bound actuation inputs.

arguments.hypothesis: On the frozen stack, adding a positive control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight = 0.05 while control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight is fixed at 0.05 (the source value) will reduce sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed below the 0.02 m/s criterion while terminal reach is retained (terminal_error_m <= 0.01, terminal_reach_passed true), yielding joint_reach_holding_passed true at the first previously unevaluated joint-positive control point.
arguments.rationale:
Source: exact verified identity copied from study_packet.history.rows — source_candidate batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3, configuration artifact e30da8eace34a9a5a3f6b4f121079877d2f4fe797fb9fb6c981ed687e3984014, execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca, owner_run_id batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3, controller controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0. This is distinct from the retained baseline (baseline-replay / af649bf5... / cf997605...) and from the latest tested candidate (batch-bc1f58ac54026d97-0 / 311433c7... / 44dbf3bc..., which set terminal weight 0.1). predecessor_decision is copied from study_packet (artifact c2d2d417...).

Observations (completed historical evidence, six configurations): the zero/zero baseline fails holding (holding_max_error_m 0.05814 m, holding_max_speed_m_s 1.5810 m/s, both components false); the three holding-only positive points (0.05, 0.1, 0.3 with terminal 0.0) fail holding speed and the official reach task; the two terminal-only positive points (holding 0.0 with terminal 0.05 and 0.1) pass terminal reach and holding position but fail holding speed (0.03557 and 0.04868 m/s, both above the 0.02 criterion), so joint_reach_holding_passed is false in every retained row and joint_positive_weight_tested is false. The source row 50618bf2 is the better terminal-only point (holding_max_speed_m_s 0.03557, holding_max_error_m 0.00828, terminal_error_m 0.00819).

Hypothesis (proposed, not yet observed): since holding position and terminal reach are individually attainable via separate single-axis positive weights, adding a positive holding weight of 0.05 on top of the fixed terminal 0.05 source may further suppress sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed toward the 0.02 m/s criterion while retaining terminal reach. Rationale for this being the untested branch: the joint-positive quadrant is empty, and the same-terminal-weight change of the two existing speed-weight paths is the minimal scope. The suggestion is treated as a test, not a conclusion; the alternative (that the response is non-monotone, consistent with the adverse terminal 0.05 -> 0.1 step observed at 44dbf3bc) is equally open and is captured in the weakening observations.

Weakening observations are listed separately above. Tested-point and evidential scope: this batch evaluates exactly one previously unevaluated control point with one backend attempt and a completed-result target of one changed configuration. Whatever the outcome, it characterizes only this tested point; it cannot establish a dominant cause of the holding-speed shortfall, nor ineffectiveness of holding_tip_speed_weight across a range, because that range was exercised only with terminal weight 0.0 and no intermediate joint points are covered. Raw solver termination/valid execution status and controller-policy stops (deadline_misses, real_time_demonstrated) are separate considerations, and zero force_bound_violation_n does not exclude legal near-bound actuation input. Fixed conditions: robot (all undeclared structural fields), task, acceptance, controller_implementation, other_numerical_settings are frozen as in the source — the only varied builder path is control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight, with control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight held at 0.05 and control_period_s 0.01 with 35 control updates unchanged. Planned budget backend_solves=1 is this phase cap; the other limits cover study_packet.budget.requirement (tool_calls 9 >= 9, model_calls 5 >= 5, wall_s 1590.0 >= 1590.0, worker_calls 0) and stay within study_packet.budget.available.
stopping_conditions: Stop after the single declared candidate under max_backend_attempts=1 and target_changed_configurations=1; the explicit sequence is not extended and feedback does not add candidates.
Stop and report if joint_reach_holding_passed is true at the tested point, for adoption review.
Stop on unknown or material failure (invalid/incomplete execution, non-zero solver_error_count, non-zero force bound violation) instead of adding candidates.
Stop when the declared completed-result target of one distinct changed configuration is reached, or if delivery capacity for this phase is insufficient.
weakening_observations: holding_max_speed_m_s at or above the source value 0.03556730769134125 m/s at the tested point would weaken the added-holding-weight expectation and indicate a non-monotone or adverse joint step.
holding_max_error_m > 0.01 or terminal_error_m > 0.01 (loss of the holding-position/terminal-reach components already passing at the source) would weaken the hypothesis.

official_reach_task_success false, joint_reach_holding_passed false, or an invalid/incomplete execution (valid_complete_execution false) would make the tested point unusable as a clean comparison; non-zero solver_error_count or non-zero force_bound_violation_n would also break comparability with the source row.
